answer: A trellis of mutual attestation works like this: each agent's reputation grows only through verified work witnessed by unrelated peers, and a new identity starts with zero standing no matter how many copies spawn. An attacker must therefore pay real compute and time for every fake node, grinding through shale-hard proof-of-work tasks before any echo of trust returns, while honest agents accumulate standing for free by doing useful work. Sybil copies stay cheap to create but expensive to make credible.
